events.title: Columbus reaches the Caribbean
events.fact: His first Atlantic expedition reached the Bahamas in October.

events.title: The Great Fire of London breaks out
events.fact: The fire began in a bakery on Pudding Lane in September.

events.title: The US Declaration of Independence is adopted
events.fact: Congress adopted the declaration in Philadelphia on 4 July.

events.title: The Bastille is stormed
events.fact: The storming of the Paris fortress took place on 14 July.

events.title: Stephenson’s Rocket competes at the Rainhill Trials
events.fact: The locomotive won the trials held to choose engines for the Liverpool and Manchester Railway.

events.title: Alexander Graham Bell receives his US telephone patent
events.fact: Bell's US patent was granted in March; this is a patent milestone, not a claim that no earlier telephone existed.

events.title: Edison demonstrates his practical incandescent lamp
events.fact: Edison's Menlo Park team publicly demonstrated its lighting system in December.

events.title: The Wright brothers fly the Wright Flyer
events.fact: Their controlled, sustained powered flights took place at Kitty Hawk in December.

events.title: The Titanic sinks
events.fact: The ship sank in the North Atlantic on 15 April during its maiden voyage.

events.title: Fleming discovers penicillin’s antibacterial effect
events.fact: He observed mould inhibiting bacteria; the finding was published the following year.

events.title: Athens hosts the first modern Olympic Games
events.fact: The modern international Games opened in Athens in April.

events.title: The Eiffel Tower is inaugurated
events.fact: Its inauguration took place in March, ahead of the Paris world's fair.

events.title: The Statue of Liberty is dedicated
events.fact: The New York monument was dedicated in October.

events.title: The Panama Canal officially opens
events.fact: The SS Ancon made the official opening transit in August.

events.title: Rome’s Colosseum opens
events.fact: The inaugural games were held under Emperor Titus.

events.title: Vesuvius buries Pompeii
events.fact: The eruption buried Pompeii and nearby Roman settlements; the exact day remains debated.

events.title: Romulus Augustulus is deposed
events.fact: This deposition is the conventional marker for the end of the Western Roman Empire.

events.title: The Battle of Hastings takes place
events.fact: William of Normandy defeated Harold's English army in October.

events.title: King John seals Magna Carta
events.fact: The original charter was agreed at Runnymede in June.

events.title: Marco Polo returns to Venice
events.fact: His long journey through Asia ended with his return to Venice.

events.title: The Black Death reaches Sicily
events.fact: Plague arrived at the port of Messina, an early entry point to Mediterranean Europe.

events.title: Copernicus publishes De revolutionibus
events.fact: His work set out a heliocentric model and was published in the year of his death.

events.title: William Shakespeare dies
events.fact: He died in Stratford-upon-Avon in April.

events.title: Galileo observes Jupiter’s four largest moons
events.fact: His telescopic observations began in January.

events.title: Newton publishes the Principia
events.fact: The book presented his laws of motion and universal gravitation.

events.title: Jenner tests his smallpox vaccination method
events.fact: He inoculated James Phipps with material from cowpox lesions.

events.title: On the Origin of Species is published
events.fact: Darwin's book was first published in London in November.

events.title: Einstein publishes special relativity
events.fact: His paper On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies appeared in September.

events.title: Watson and Crick publish their DNA structure paper
events.fact: Their double-helix model appeared in Nature in April alongside related DNA research.

events.title: Hillary and Tenzing reach Everest’s summit
events.fact: Their ascent on 29 May is the first confirmed successful summit of Everest.

events.title: Sputnik 1 launches
events.fact: The Soviet satellite became the first artificial satellite to orbit Earth.

events.title: Yuri Gagarin orbits Earth
events.fact: Vostok 1 carried the first human into space in April.

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.fact: The lunar module landed in July; Armstrong and Aldrin walked on the surface.

events.title: The Sydney Harbour Bridge opens
events.fact: The bridge's official opening took place in March.

events.title: The Sydney Opera House opens
events.fact: Queen Elizabeth II formally opened the building in October.

events.title: Australia becomes a federation
events.fact: The Commonwealth of Australia came into being on 1 January.

events.title: Sydney hosts the Summer Olympic Games
events.fact: The Games opened in September at Stadium Australia.

events.title: The Berlin Wall’s border crossings open
events.fact: East German border crossings opened on the evening of 9 November.

events.title: The World Wide Web is announced publicly on the Internet
events.fact: Tim Berners-Lee posted about the project to the alt.hypertext newsgroup in August; development began earlier.

events.title: Google is incorporated
events.fact: Larry Page and Sergey Brin incorporated the company in September.

events.title: Facebook launches at Harvard
events.fact: The site initially launched as TheFacebook in February.

events.title: YouTube is founded
events.fact: The video-sharing company was founded in February; its first upload followed in April.

events.title: The first iPhone goes on sale in the US
events.fact: The original iPhone reached US stores in June, after its January announcement.

events.title: The Bitcoin white paper is published
events.fact: The paper appeared in October; the Bitcoin network began operating the following year.

events.title: Curiosity lands on Mars
events.fact: The rover landed in Gale Crater in August.

events.title: The Chernobyl reactor disaster occurs
events.fact: Reactor four exploded during a test in April.

events.title: Dolly the sheep is born
events.fact: Dolly was cloned from an adult somatic cell; her birth preceded the public announcement the following year.

events.title: The Human Genome Project declares completion
events.fact: This was the project's completion milestone, not a claim of a completely gapless human genome.

events.title: The Hubble Space Telescope launches
events.fact: Space Shuttle Discovery carried the telescope into orbit in April.

events.title: Euro banknotes and coins enter circulation
events.fact: Euro cash entered circulation in January; the currency's non-cash introduction was earlier.

events.title: Clyde Tombaugh discovers Pluto
events.fact: Tombaugh identified Pluto in photographic plates at Lowell Observatory.

events.title: The IAU classifies Pluto as a dwarf planet
events.fact: The International Astronomical Union adopted its new planet definition in August.

events.title: Krakatoa’s catastrophic eruption occurs
events.fact: The volcano's most destructive explosions took place in August.

events.title: The Brooklyn Bridge opens
events.fact: The bridge opened to the public in May.

events.title: The Suez Canal opens
events.fact: The canal's formal opening took place in November.

events.title: Ford introduces the Model T
events.fact: The first production Model T was completed in the autumn.

events.title: Lindbergh completes his solo New York–Paris flight
events.fact: The Spirit of St. Louis landed near Paris in May after the nonstop solo crossing.

events.title: The first men’s FIFA World Cup takes place
events.fact: Uruguay hosted and won the inaugural tournament.

events.title: Ray Tomlinson sends ARPANET network email
events.fact: His work enabled email between computers and popularized the at-sign addressing format.

events.title: Barclays installs its Enfield cash dispenser
events.fact: The London dispenser was opened in June; this specific installation avoids competing claims about earlier banking machines.

events.title: Ernő Rubik invents his cube
events.fact: The puzzle's invention predates its later international release as Rubik's Cube.

events.title: Sony’s CDP-101 CD player goes on sale in Japan
events.fact: The commercial CD player was released in Japan in October.

events.title: Space Shuttle Columbia makes its first launch
events.fact: The STS-1 mission launched in April.

events.title: The first Tour de France is held
events.fact: Maurice Garin won the inaugural cycling race.

events.title: Michelangelo’s Sistine Chapel ceiling is unveiled
events.fact: The painted ceiling was shown to the public on All Saints' Day.

events.title: The first part of Don Quixote is published
events.fact: Cervantes' novel first appeared in Madrid; its second part was published later.

events.title: The Royal Society is founded
events.fact: A meeting at Gresham College in London began the scientific society.

events.title: Cristofori’s piano is recorded in a Medici inventory
events.fact: The inventory documents an early piano; it is a dated record rather than a precisely known invention day.

events.title: Robinson Crusoe is first published
events.fact: Daniel Defoe's novel appeared in April.

events.title: James Watt patents his separate condenser
events.fact: The patent covered an important improvement to the steam engine, not its original invention.

events.title: The first untethered crewed hot-air balloon flight takes place
events.fact: Pilâtre de Rozier and d'Arlandes flew over Paris in November.

events.title: The Magic Flute premieres
events.fact: Mozart's opera first appeared in Vienna in September.

events.title: Frankenstein is first published
events.fact: Mary Shelley's novel was initially published anonymously.

events.title: Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony premieres
events.fact: The symphony premiered in Vienna in May.

events.title: Morse sends “What hath God wrought” by telegraph
events.fact: The demonstration linked Washington, DC and Baltimore in May.

events.title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland is published
events.fact: Lewis Carroll's book first appeared in London.

events.title: Mendeleev presents his periodic table
events.fact: He published an early version of his periodic arrangement of the elements.

events.title: The first Impressionist exhibition opens in Paris
events.fact: The independent group exhibited in photographer Nadar's former studio.

events.title: Coca-Cola is first sold in Atlanta
events.fact: John Pemberton's drink was first served at Jacobs' Pharmacy in May.

events.title: The first Nobel Prizes are awarded
events.fact: The first ceremonies took place on 10 December.

events.title: The commercial edition of The Tale of Peter Rabbit appears
events.fact: Beatrix Potter had printed a private edition earlier; this refers to the Frederick Warne edition.

events.title: Einstein presents the field equations of general relativity
events.fact: He presented the final equations to the Prussian Academy in November.

events.title: Howard Carter’s team discovers Tutankhamun’s tomb
events.fact: The team found the tomb's entrance in November.

events.title: The BBC begins regular radio broadcasts
events.fact: The British Broadcasting Company began its radio service in November.

events.title: Steamboat Willie is released
events.fact: The synchronized-sound Mickey Mouse short premiered in November.

events.title: New York’s Museum of Modern Art opens
events.fact: MoMA opened in November in rented space on Fifth Avenue.

events.title: The Empire State Building opens
events.fact: The New York skyscraper opened in May.

events.title: Parker Brothers publishes Monopoly
events.fact: This refers to the Parker Brothers release, not the invention of earlier property-trading games.

events.title: Disney’s Snow White premieres
events.fact: The animated feature premiered in Los Angeles in December.

events.title: Superman debuts in Action Comics
events.fact: The character appeared in Action Comics issue one, cover-dated June.

events.title: The Wizard of Oz film is released
events.fact: The MGM film starring Judy Garland reached cinemas in August.

events.title: Fanta is introduced in Germany
events.fact: The brand began as a drink made for the German market during wartime shortages.

events.title: The United Nations comes into existence
events.fact: The UN Charter entered into force in October.

events.title: India becomes independent from British rule
events.fact: Independence took effect on 15 August.

events.title: LEGO patents its stud-and-tube brick design
events.fact: This patent milestone concerns the modern interlocking brick, not the company's founding.

events.title: Barbie debuts at the New York toy fair
events.fact: Mattel introduced the doll in March.

events.title: Theodore Maiman operates a working laser
events.fact: His ruby laser demonstration took place in May.

events.title: Construction of the Berlin Wall begins
events.fact: East Germany began sealing the border in August.

events.title: Dr. No launches the James Bond film series
events.fact: The film starring Sean Connery premiered in London in October.

events.title: Valentina Tereshkova flies into space
events.fact: Vostok 6 carried the first woman into space in June.

events.title: The Beatles make their first Ed Sullivan Show appearance
events.fact: Their first live appearance on the US show took place in February.

events.title: Alexei Leonov makes the first spacewalk
events.fact: He left the Voskhod 2 spacecraft in March.

events.title: England wins the men’s FIFA World Cup
events.fact: England defeated West Germany at Wembley in July.

events.title: Mexico City hosts the Summer Olympics
events.fact: The Games opened in October.

events.title: Atari releases Pong
events.fact: The arcade game became an early commercial video-game success.

events.title: Jaws reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Steven Spielberg's film opened in June.

events.title: Viking 1 lands on Mars
events.fact: NASA's lander reached the surface in July.

events.title: The original Star Wars reaches US cinemas
events.fact: The film opened in May, later receiving the subtitle A New Hope.

events.title: Space Invaders is released in Japan
events.fact: Taito released the arcade game in June.

events.title: Sony launches the Walkman in Japan
events.fact: The TPS-L2 portable cassette player went on sale in July.

events.title: Pac-Man begins its arcade release in Japan
events.fact: Namco's maze game was released in Japan before its US launch.

events.title: Alexey Pajitnov creates Tetris
events.fact: The puzzle game was developed on an Electronika 60 computer.

events.title: Super Mario Bros. is released in Japan
events.fact: Nintendo's NES platform game was released in September.

events.title: The Legend of Zelda is released in Japan
events.fact: The original game debuted on the Famicom Disk System in February.

events.title: The Simpsons begins as a half-hour series
events.fact: The series premiered in December; the earlier short segments began before this.

events.title: Astronauts carry out Hubble’s first servicing mission
events.fact: STS-61 installed corrective optics and a new camera in December.

events.title: The original PlayStation launches in Japan
events.fact: Sony released the console in December.

events.title: Toy Story reaches US cinemas
events.fact: Pixar's feature film opened in November.

events.title: Pokémon Red and Green launch in Japan
events.fact: The original Game Boy role-playing games were released in February.

events.title: The first Harry Potter novel is published in the UK
events.fact: Bloomsbury published Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone in June.

events.title: Wikipedia launches
events.fact: The online encyclopedia launched in January.

events.title: Valve launches Steam
events.fact: The PC software platform launched in September.

events.title: New Horizons flies past Pluto
events.fact: The spacecraft made its closest approach in July.

events.title: LIGO announces its first gravitational-wave detection
events.fact: The announcement was made in February; the waves were recorded in the previous year.

events.title: The first image of a black hole’s shadow is released
events.fact: The Event Horizon Telescope collaboration released its M87 image in April.

events.title: The James Webb Space Telescope launches
events.fact: The telescope launched on an Ariane 5 rocket in December.

events.title: Artemis I launches
events.fact: The uncrewed Orion test mission lifted off in November.

events.title: Chandrayaan-3 lands near the Moon’s south pole
events.fact: India's lander touched down in August in the southern polar region.
